definitions.executable: System reaches tool execution: FW-A/FW-B front-end request with an operation that has a template; agents front-end request and M07 status plan; A1 raw M07 plan.
definitions.secondary_pass: Diagnostic, non-official: same prediction, every component passed except required_steps is ignored. Not an M11b pass rate and not end-to-end validation.
definitions.stdev: Across runs: sample standard deviation; within a run: population standard deviation.
definitions.strict_pass: Official M11b v2.0 TaskScore.passed (scorer unchanged); primary metric.
definitions.subsets: full: every task; common_executable: executable by fixed_workflow, dynamic_agent and validator_replan; agent_executable: by both agents; decision: benchmark expects non-success; supported_unexecutable_by_formal: supported tasks no formal config executes.
definitions.tool_sequence: Analysis tools of the pass that produced the returned result; retries and validate_geometry checks count in tool_calls only.
